description: Ca₂NaZn₂V₃O₁₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/acd space group. Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.51 Å) and four longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ca is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.56 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. All V-O bond lengths are 1.75 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-51°. There are two shorter (1.74 Å) and two longer (1.76 Å) V-O bond lengths. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra. All Zn-O bond lengths are 2.12 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ca, one V, and one Zn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaCaVZn trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ca, one V, and one Zn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ca, one V, and one Zn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaCaVZn trigonal pyramids.
